what: slope: An R Package for Geomorphometric Analysis
title: slope: An R Package for Identify Slope Patterns and Processes
text: slope experimental R package providing distinct geomorphometric approaches, commonly unavailable traditional GIS environments, focused reproducibility replicability geomorphometric analyses. Additionally, scope project implements classical geomorphometric methods fundamental scientific community. citation: Marques Filho, J. da P. (2026). marquesfilhojp/slope: slope: Identify slope patterns processes (Version v0.3.2) [Computer software]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21325742

title: Thematic Susceptibility Mapping — thematic_susceptibility_mapping
text: Performing different forms thematic susceptibility mapping machine learning, based Filho et al. (2024).

title: Thematic Susceptibility Mapping — thematic_susceptibility_mapping
code: thematic_susceptibility_mapping(   x,   y,   target_col,   p,   drop_cols,   k_folds,   method,   mtry,   ntree,   cost,   preProcess,   n_class,   predict,   path_metrics,   path_var_imp,   path_prediction )

title: Thematic Susceptibility Mapping — thematic_susceptibility_mapping
text: x Input stack raster y Input samples (vector files) target_col Target field occurrence p Regarding number samples representing non-occurrence events, suggested, order balance sample set, use sample size equal number event occurrences. drop_cols allows remove information used susceptibility modeling. k_folds Number folds number resampling iterations, using cross-validation method. method Random Forest "rf" Support Vector Machine "svm" mtry Randomly selected predictors ntree Decision tree number cost Constraint violation cost, 'C' regularization parameter. preProcess Estimates required parameters operation (e.g., 'nzv' near-zero variance filtering, c('center', 'scale') normalization). details available pre-processing methods, see caret package R documentation. n_class positive class value confusion matrix (e.g., 0 non-occurrence 1 occurrence). predict Predicted thematic susceptibility status, 0 indicates non-occurrence 1 indicates occurrence. path_metrics Path save machine learning model metrics tabular format. path_var_imp Path save machine learning model variable importance tabular format. path_prediction Path save susceptibility prediction raster/matrix format.

title: Thematic Susceptibility Mapping — thematic_susceptibility_mapping
code: library(terra) library(slope) rasters <- terra::rast(system.file("ex/stack.tif", package = "terra")) #> Error: [rast] filename is empty. Provide a valid filename samples <- terra::vect(system.file("ex/samples.shp", package = "terra")) #> Error: [vect] file does not exist:  tsm <- slope::thematic_susceptibility_mapping(rasters, samples, "classes", 0.7, -c(1,3,15), 5, "rf", 10, 1000, NULL,                                              "nzv", 1, 2, "ex/metrics.txt", "ex/var_imp.txt", "ex/predict.tif") #> Error: object 'rasters' not found plot(tsm) #> Error in h(simpleError(msg, call)): error in evaluating the argument 'x' in selecting a method for function 'plot': object 'tsm' not found
